verdict.rationale: Asking whether a hosted database/backend platform uses customer data for AI training is a fair privacy question, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no Convex policy, setting, or contractual commitment about AI model training. Self-hosting and the --disable-beacon telemetry flag are adjacent controls, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
